title.en: How to Order Custom Printed Cupcake Liners from a Factory
title.zh: 如何向工厂定制印刷蛋糕纸托

description.en: A practical outline for preparing artwork, confirming cup specifications, reviewing mockups and planning a custom wholesale inquiry.
description.zh: 梳理图稿、杯型规格、效果图确认、打样和包装需求，便于与工厂沟通定制采购。

bodyEn:

Outline: describe the cup style, intended use and packaging format. Gather reference artwork before discussing a production specification.

Draft paragraph: We support custom logos, sizes, colors and packaging. Our factory-direct pricing is prepared for wholesale requirements; an actual quotation depends on confirmed specifications.

## 明确定制杯型与用途

写作提纲：先整理杯型、使用场景和包装方式，再准备图案参考，与工厂确认生产规格。

占位段落：我们支持标志、尺寸、颜色和包装定制，并提供适合批发采购的工厂直供报价。实际报价需要结合确认后的规格。

## 准备印刷图稿

### 标志与设计文件

提纲：提供标志图稿，并说明希望呈现的位置。文件格式及可印刷区域请与工厂核对：[TODO]。

### 颜色与版面
